notes.title: July 2025 Updates
notes.content:
Changelog - Version 1.0.2a
This update focuses on polishing the user experience and fixing minor issues.

Fixed
Pause Menu Input: Addressed an issue where input continued to be registered while the game was paused, preventing unintended actions.

Level Configuration: Resolved minor inconsistencies and bugs in various level configurations.

Localization/Labels: Corrected errors in several in-game text labels and tags.
